## Tentative tests

| Test | Result | Subtests | Kind | Description |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| [`FileSystemFileHandle-cross-primitive-locking.https.tentative.worker.js`](https://wpt.fyi/results/fs/FileSystemFileHandle-cross-primitive-locking.https.tentative.worker.js) | Error | 64 / 90 | NOT IMPLEMENTED | the locks of the `move()` and `remove()` operations in progress (the locking proposal of Chromium, not in the File System Standard): the test starts a move or a removal without waiting for it and expects another primitive to be rejected meanwhile, but the operations of the library are done when they are called, so the primitive is created and its lock is not released by the test (the following subtests then fail on the leaked lock); the locks of the writable streams and of the access handles pass, and the test also fails in Chromium (66 of 90) |
| [`FileSystemFileHandle-sync-access-handle-back-forward-cache.https.tentative.window.js`](https://wpt.fyi/results/fs/FileSystemFileHandle-sync-access-handle-back-forward-cache.https.tentative.window.js) | Fail | 1 / 2 | NOT IMPLEMENTED | the back/forward cache does not keep a document with an open `FileSystemSyncAccessHandle` (the browsers keep it and evict it when an active document needs a contentious lock on the file): the document is destroyed by the navigation, which releases its access handles, so the second subtest's `history.back()` loads it again |
| [`FileSystemFileHandle-sync-access-handle-lock-modes.https.tentative.worker.js`](https://wpt.fyi/results/fs/FileSystemFileHandle-sync-access-handle-lock-modes.https.tentative.worker.js) | Pass | 33 / 33 |  |  |
| [`FileSystemFileHandle-writable-file-stream-back-forward-cache.https.tentative.window.js`](https://wpt.fyi/results/fs/FileSystemFileHandle-writable-file-stream-back-forward-cache.https.tentative.window.js) | Fail | 1 / 2 | NOT IMPLEMENTED | the back/forward cache does not keep a document with an open `FileSystemWritableFileStream` (the browsers keep it and evict it when an active document needs a contentious lock on the file): the document is destroyed by the navigation, which aborts its streams, so the BFCache executor reports a failed precondition |
